hook.name: EBlockHook
hook.description: Enforces a fixed 2.5% ETH-denominated fee on swaps in a single configured pool, collected via beforeSwap and afterSwap return deltas. Token purchase amounts are tracked in transient storage for consumption by an external lottery/token contract. Fees accumulate and are distributed to the lottery contract via a permissionless `distributeFees()` call. The buyback executor is exempt from fee collection.
